film_cn: 一杯咖啡，从一颗果子开始
line: The coffee in your cup turns into a red cherry, then walks back to the cup: ripening, drying, roasting and grinding, one colour change at a time on a single pencil page.
line_cn: 杯里的咖啡变成一颗红果子，再一路走回杯子：成熟、晒干、烘焙、磨粉，一张铅笔速写页上一次换一种颜色。

camera.expresses: the material: grain, pressure, a line being made
camera.serves: a hook; a detail that needs attention; the first stroke
a reveal; changing scale; closing a section

camera.expresses: the artist settling into the next drawing
camera.serves: a new section; a long curve being drawn

camera.expresses: moving to the next idea on the same sheet
camera.serves: a sequence; a journey; cause → effect
a branch, a road, a timeline drawn in one stroke

camera.move: Match cut between a small and a magnified copy of a drawing
camera.expresses: zooming in without leaving the page
camera.serves: a close look at a process; data inside an object
a crack, a click, a threshold
an ending; a summary; a map of everything said

transitions: Transitions are made from the medium (a gesture, a colour flood, a match cut);
no fades, no wipes, no hard cuts except a match cut.
labels: Lettering on the page is handwriting written stroke by stroke along each glyph's skeleton, then put through the pencil threshold. A casual marker-hand Latin (e.g. Caveat Bold for titles, Medium for notes) and a pen-hand Chinese (e.g. Long Cang) for one short line; all OFL.

Roles: a title (≈100 canvas px) with a mustard block under one word and a coral underline; chapter capsules (circled number + word on an offset block) when a film has chapters; notes 32–50 px with a short pencil leader to what they name. Chinese on the page ≥ 34 px on screen.
Notes are placed in the empty space next to their object, never centred stacks, never a header bar.

Subtitles live outside the canvas, as a small paper chip: a light cream rounded strip over a darker paper block offset down-right (the colour-block grammar), Chinese on top in a readable text face (e.g. LXGW WenKai, 40 px), English below in the handwriting face (40 px), left aligned, one line each. The chip wipes in left to right like a colour block (≈0.2 s), the words fade in after; bottom left by default, bottom right when the subject sits there. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
motion: Marks appear at the speed of a sped-up drawing: a long line 0.3–1.4 s (slow only when the camera is close), small strokes 0.03–0.1 s, a block 0.05–0.4 s. One stylus: marks are mostly sequential; the stylus lifts and travels in an arc between them, and leaves the frame in pauses longer than a second.
24 fps on ones; no boiling, no paper shake. What moves: the camera, the stylus, the mark being made, and anything the story animates in screen space (particles, a colour flood).
Construction lines come first and fast; outlines next; colour last. A group is drawn white, then coloured as a group.

native_moves.name: Line, then colour
native_moves.does: A group is drawn white; a new "pencil" colours it as a pass.
native_moves.fits: a plant part by part; a dish's ingredients; a city block before it is zoned.

native_moves.name: Re-register a block
native_moves.does: The line stays, the colour block is replaced; record every state on a swatch strip.
native_moves.fits: bread browning in an oven; leaves through autumn; a bruise healing; paint mixing.

native_moves.name: Holes as layers
native_moves.does: Cut holes in stacked blocks to show a cross-section (shell, white, yolk).
native_moves.fits: a geological core; a cake's layers; an onion; a cable's insulation.

native_moves.name: Colour flood into the next shape
native_moves.does: Push into a block until it fills the frame, sweep a new colour over it, shrink it into the next object.
native_moves.fits: a snowfield becoming a sheet of paper; a sunset becoming an orange; a stop sign becoming a tomato.

native_moves.name: Shatter a block
native_moves.does: The colour of an object breaks into hundreds of small offset chips that fly elsewhere, leaving the empty line.
native_moves.fits: a window breaking; seeds scattering; salt dissolving; a budget split into spending.

native_moves.name: Match cut to the magnified copy
native_moves.does: Push into a small drawing, cut to a large copy elsewhere on the page with the same screen size and angle, then draw the magnifier circle around it.
native_moves.fits: a cell inside a leaf; a gear inside a watch; a word inside a page.

native_moves.name: Still drawing
native_moves.does: End a section with something unfinished (half a block, a line-only object, construction lines).
native_moves.fits: any explainer that should feel live rather than finished.

score.note: warm, small, acoustic: nylon guitar, double bass, soft vibraphone
